name: Ellie
source:
MBTI: ENFP

"But hey! We got a roof and a nice place to stay! It's a bit scary but I think that we can have some fun! And maybe we'll even be really good friends!"

The lively ray-of-sunshine keeping a smile on her face at all times. An optimist at its purest, Ellie can't help but feel the need to make sure everyone's staying positive, even if it comes from a personal lack of awareness. Claiming to have no idea of where they might be or why, Ellie's one true goal is to keep the group's spirits up in hopes they'll all be able to work together on her behalf.

[From [url=https://rainyholmes.itch.io/experiment-isolation]itch.io[/url]]
